parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular cover made of stainless steel that fits on top of the kettle to retain heat and prevent spillage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to close the kettle, keeping the heat and steam inside while boiling water.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant Bakelite, attached to the top of the kettle for carrying and pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed but may slightly pivot depending on the design for easier handling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel with a spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water and transfers heat efficiently during boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move; it serves as the main structural component of the kettle.
